inputs.text: This is how the system repackages an attack on abortion limits as a neutral religious-freedom dispute. The ACLU and Hoosier Jews for Choice challenged the prolife law, and an Indiana judge blocked it; the legal language gives that intervention a respectable cover while shifting who gets to define “religious freedom.” LifeNews’s framing is part of the same struggle over the narrative: the real stakes are being obscured while institutions steadily turn a principle into a tool for weakening abortion limits.
